name: The Fool
description: Represents the dawn of an adventure, stepping boldly into the unknown with purity of heart, infinite possibilities, and openness to life.

name: The Magician
description: Represents channeling creative and mental power into physical reality. You possess all the resources and talent required to manifest your desires.

name: The High Priestess
description: Represents listening to deep intuition, unseen spiritual truths, quiet contemplative wisdom, and trusting your inner voice.

name: The Empress
description: Represents natural abundance, radiant fertility, creative gestation, nurturing growth, and harmonious connection to physical pleasures.

name: The Emperor
description: Represents establishing order from chaotic forces, creating enduring structures, sound boundaries, and providing disciplined leadership.

name: The Herophant
description: Represents seeking higher learning, grounded tradition, sacred institutions, mentorship, and aligning with ethical codes of conduct.

name: The Lovers
description: Represents profound partnership, emotional and spiritual intimacy, and making pivotal choices that align with your highest moral values.

name: The Chariot
description: Represents conquering internal and external obstacles through focused determination, master of dual impulses, and driving toward victory.

name: The Strength
description: Represents taming passions and facing adversity through gentle mastery, compassionate conviction, emotional endurance, and quiet resilience.

name: The Hermit
description: Represents withdrawing from outer distractions to illuminate your personal truth, engaging in quiet reflection, and finding inner clarity.

name: Wheel Of Fortune
description: Represents the perpetual cycles of fate, fortunate shifts in circumstances, recognizing timely opportunities, and adapting to life's rhythm.

name: Justice
description: Represents lucid fairness, impartial truth-seeking, balance of cause and consequence, moral accountability, and clear discernment.

name: The Hanged Man
description: Represents the wisdom of non-action, intentionally pausing to view situations upside-down, releasing the need to control outcomes.

name: Death
description: Represents the absolute closing of obsolete cycles, peeling away outdated identities, and clearing the spiritual soil for profound rebirth.

name: Temperance
description: Represents blending opposites into harmonious synthesis, cultivating quiet patience, inner poise, and healing through balance.

name: The Devil
description: Represents recognizing self-limiting bonds, addictions to control or material comforts, and realizing the chains holding you are loose enough to remove.

name: The Tower
description: Represents the sudden lightning bolt that collapses false structures and illusions, paving the path for honest, authentic foundation-building.

name: The Star
description: Represents tranquil healing after turbulent storms, replenished faith, creative and spiritual inspiration, and optimism for the journey.

name: The Moon
description: Represents navigating through murky illusions or subconscious anxieties, facing hidden fears, and relying on instinctive wisdom.

name: The Sun
description: Represents triumphant celebration, luminous clarity, vibrant good health, joyful self-expression, and unhindered success.
